bias.en: Downtrend · broke $650, into the May gap
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $650，跌入 5月跳空缺口

read.en: Micron fell 13.9% on Nov 20 to $594.51, its lowest close since May 4, trading $585.25–668.99 on heavy volume (1.84x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($684.3), 10-day ($726.8), 30-day ($828.3) and 100-day ($920.4), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($772.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($814.83), and RSI is 29.5, oversold.
read.zh: 美光 11月20日下跌 13.9%，收于 $594.51，为 5月4日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $585.25–668.99，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.84 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$684.3）、10 日（$726.8）、30 日（$828.3）和 100 日均线（$920.4）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$772.5）。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$814.83），RSI 为 29.5，处于超卖区。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $650–689 (Nov 5, 17 and 18 lows), now resistance, and closed inside the May 4–5 gap ($592.8–605.5). Resistance is $605.5, then $640–652 and $667–669 (Nov 17 low, Nov 20 high). Support is $585.3–592.8 (Nov 20 low, May 4 high), then $557.8–576.5 (May 4 low and close) and $546. A close above $605.5 would target $640–652; below $585, $558–576.

r.en: May 5 low $605.47, top of the May gap
May 5 close $640.20; Nov 5 low $650, lost; May 19 low $652.21
